uiReviewer.name: Schrodinger
uiReviewer.report:
# Independent final Web Flow home UI review — 96/100

**The final candidate meets the ≥95 target within the reviewed UI scope.** The earlier **92/100 is historical**. The increase reflects reduced onboarding space, improved readability and control sizing, and corrected stability evidence using the same rubric.

## Final candidate identity

All **11 source files** matched their entries in `artifacts/webflow-home-hierarchy-20261107/candidate-sha256.json`.

| Candidate source | SHA256 |
|---|---|
| `projects/webflow/trusted/AutoSettings.tsx` | `fbcd83c6871da6c34024d079f634aead59d0a10b9b2e3b6288325cca81164888` |
| `projects/webflow/trusted/CurrentTask.tsx` | `aab1ae40b1a007263f6f7c3bd19d9cb74e2516e744c03437e55933af4db5de1f` |
| `projects/webflow/trusted/RuntimePanel.tsx` | `a843e5986f82526329ab1da5b3181c8d075fb8abbc4268e621059cef962fd399` |
| `projects/webflow/src/ui/main.js` | `554ce2bdbf78d87f6b5f9c5c3851d7188bd00e30be6ddd9a6b99c68bd87bb156` |
| `projects/webflow/src/ui/style.css` | `64cdf4761397d58a4963bf413e30129bcb9e77924726a4f6d843e1f4d5f51ccc` |
| `projects/webflow/src/ui/model.js` | `dee959d35a73c8003977da8d6d4b953ebd959111eec544380157438967e607f8` |

## Rubric and remaining deductions

| Criterion | Score | Evidence and deduction |
|---|---:|---|
| Information hierarchy | **19/20** | Automatic-run controls, listener status, critical notices, and application content remain clearly ordered. Collapsed onboarding gives recent activity greater prominence. **−1:** interpreting “已关闭” alongside green “监听就绪” still requires understanding independent states; the fuller explanation is inside details. |
| Space efficiency | **19/20** | The idle onboarding/action card occupies approximately **168–173 px**, compared with approximately 344 px previously at 320 px width. Recent manual activity is fully visible in both 900 px-high idle/no-candidate captures. **−1:** refresh occupies a separate action row at both widths, leaving some avoidable whitespace. |
| Interaction | **19/20** | Recorded keyboard/touch/IME/Escape behavior passes. Panel drafts survive closing/reopening, and Escape returns focus. Manual checking acknowledges a pending read with busy/disabled state without creating another request. **−1:** stopping requires opening the progress/stop panel before reaching cancellation. |
| Accessibility | **14/15** | Overview text and actions are larger; key homepage actions and disclosures have 44 px minimum heights. Focus indicators remain conspicuous in light and dark captures. **−1:** compact help/settings controls and smaller secondary text remain. Trusted homepage notes map to the **13 px body token**, so typography is not uniformly 14 px. |
| Narrow-screen stability | **15/15** | All **20 state/width cases** report no horizontal overflow. All four settled 320/360 × details closed/open cases record **five polls, zero shift, preserved focus, and preserved disclosure state**. Critical messages wrap without hiding actions. |
| Visual consistency | **10/10** | Trusted shell and sandbox remain visually cohesive through color, spacing, surfaces, borders, typography, and state treatments. Larger controls preserve the established visual language. |
| **Total** | **96/100** | **Four points deducted; UI target met.** |

## Critical-state findings

- **Unknown plus error:** both widths retain “结果未知” and the full concrete receipt failure, including original-request guidance and the statement that results will not be resent.
- **Approval:** “待批准 · 尚未执行” and “审阅授权” remain visible outside collapsed details.
- **Running:** “任务执行中” and progress/stop access remain visible at both widths. This establishes discoverability, not real Native cancellation.
- **Execution/read failure:** concrete errors remain visible. Failed reads show “监听状态未确认” rather than retaining green readiness.
- **Onboarding:** final screenshots and interaction records support keyboard opening, Escape closing, and focus return.

**Blocking UI issue: none identified within the inspected scope.**

The earlier **40.84375 px** sample is superseded by settled measurements that wait for the idle/no-notice state. It is not retained as a confirmed polling defect.

The initial snapshot-based onboarding Escape assertion was invalid driver evidence: the full-page snapshot included collapsed descendants. The final screenshot and iframe `details:not([open])` / `summary:focus` selectors establish actual closing and focus retention. No product change was required for that assertion failure.

## Exact final images inspected

All **27 images** below were visually inspected under:

`artifacts/webflow-home-hierarchy-20261107/`

| State | Images |
|---|---|
| Idle | `idle-320.png`, `idle-360.png` |
| No candidate | `no-candidate-320.png`, `no-candidate-360.png` |
| Draft | `draft-320.png`, `draft-360.png` |

| History | `history-320.png`, `history-360.png` |
| Running | `running-320.png`, `running-360.png` |
| Combined error | `combined-error-320.png`, `combined-error-360.png` |
| Execution error | `error-320.png`, `error-360.png` |
| Keyboard details | `details-keyboard-360.png` |
| Dark details | `details-dark-360.png` |
| Read failure | `read-failure-360.png` |
| Onboarding | `onboarding-open-360.png`, `onboarding-closed-360.png` |
| Panel draft | `panel-draft-360.png` |
| Manual check acknowledgement | `manual-check-ack-360.png` |

## Supporting evidence inspected

- `candidate-sha256.json`: all 11 listed files matched current source hashes.
- `browser-results.json`: **20 scenarios**, no recorded horizontal overflow; keyboard, touch, IME-safe Escape, closing, and focus results.
- `stability-details.json`: four settled width/disclosure combinations, each with five polls, **0 px shift**, retained focus/open state, and no recorded overflow.
- `panel-and-manual.json`: draft preserved; panel closed with focus returned; manual check acknowledged as busy and disabled while joining the existing read. Read count remained **79 before/after the join**, then completed.
- `onboarding-interaction.json`: keyboard opening, Escape closing, and focus return confirmed using iframe visibility/focus selectors.
- `browser-check.mjs` and `interactions-check.mjs`: inspected capture and measurement procedures.
- Final component/current-task/sandbox recovery test log, inspected at `/tmp/webflow-home-final-components.log` and copied `components-test.log`: **83 tests passed, 0 failed**.
- Relevant trusted component, sandbox UI, and styling source was inspected to ground interaction, typography, sizing, and disclosure findings.

## Evidence limitations

This is an **independent UI-only assessment** of actual React Shell/components and real sandbox UI source rendered in **ego Chromium with mocked Host boundaries**.

I inspected source, hashes, screenshots, recorded interactions, measurement procedures, and test logs. I did **not** independently rerun tests, operate browsers/services, or modify files.

**Final-candidate system Chrome, production, Native execution, and assistive-technology validation remain NOT_TESTED.** The score does not establish real authorization enforcement, task execution, cancellation, delivery, installation, or release readiness. The parallel AI Proxy source-pin validation blocker is separate from this UI assessment.

The review is complete for the frozen candidate and supplied UI evidence.
